|game_text=Plays on table. At opponent's [[Dantooine]] and Subjugated planet sites, your Imperials are deploy -2 and your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Leave Them To Me (V) (Death Star II)]]; it was replaced by the full text again (see [[Leave Them To Me (V) (Death Star II)]]). The image here is the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-23-Leave_Them_To_Me_Death_Star_II.png]]), which prints this text.
* '''Original''' ([[Leave Them To Me (V) (Death Star II)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet, first copy (official text as of 4 September 2009; slip #23)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>: “Plays on table. At opponent's Dantooine and Subjugated planet sites, your Imperials are deploy -2 and your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent. Your game text at opponent's <>Swamp and <>Jungle is canceled. Your characters present at opponent's <>Forest are immune to attrition.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the revised copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 sheet (PDF dated 20 April 2010; slip [[:File:VB6-23-Leave_Them_To_Me_Death_Star_II.png]])<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1-revised">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], revised copy (PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints only the first sentence: “Plays on table. At opponent's Dantooine and Subjugated planet sites, your Imperials are deploy -2 and your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent.”
* '''Current text''': The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1261_24-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VShieldsType), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064820/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VShieldsType.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> (writing “Subjugated Planet” with a capital P) and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> print the full original text again, as does the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VSh-D-leavethemtomev-pre.gif]]); the current card plays that text. Whether this return is a version of its own (PC-E2) is an open question for Bill; until he decides, the original page carries the current text.
